options.pcbQtyMinimum: 5 (smallest quantity on orderonline.aspx; GetDeliveryDays returns [] for 1-4)
options.method: POST https://www.pcbway.com/Quote/GetDeliveryDays/ (body captured from orderonline.aspx and quotesmt.aspx with agent-browser, replayed with curl; anonymous). Recipe: /tmp/pcbway-quote-recipe.md

notes: Track/space 5/4 mil -> '4/4mil'. Via fill -> 'Via in pad' (mutually exclusive with 'All vias filled with resin and capped'). 6-layer + via-in-pad has one build time only (10-11 days); without via-in-pad the PCB is $189.11 with a 5-6 day build. Five: no $29 promo because 43 THT joints x 5 = 215 > 100 per order (the instant quote can't check joints and still shows $29). Normal assembly at qty <= 10 = max($88, $25.27 + $0.1523 x parts/board x qty), unique parts have no effect. The struck-through 'list' price next to $29 ($373.52 at qty 1, $384.42 at qty 5) is the qty >= 11 formula and is not charged at these quantities.
